caption:
Stop stuffing a thin comforter inside your duvet cover.

A duvet cover looks fine until you shake it out and the comforter bunches in one corner, leaving the rest of the cover empty and flat. That gap is usually the comforter, not the cover.

This insert is made to sit inside a duvet cover and fill it out evenly from corner to corner. About eighty thousand people have rated it, averaging 4.7 stars.

You get a bed that looks full and even under the cover instead of lumpy in the middle, for about $35.
